resources.string: Auto-handle failed background tasks
When a background command fails, times out or is interrupted, Eta wakes an agent round to finish the work. Turn this off to only get a result notification.

The user may not be online right now. This round continues a task already authorized in an online conversation: finish it and produce the result. For example after a failed build, rerun the build, fetch the artifact and deliver the APK, carrying everything through to completion. Do not downgrade work into suggestions and do not require the user to come back and approve. The danger gate only hard-guards key areas: system partitions, the boot chain, Android-side phone data, broad deletes, remount, format, installing or uninstalling or freezing system apps and sensitive settings. A hit still shows a confirmation card for all sources alike; if nobody answers within 2 minutes that single action is not executed and is never done silently or reported as done — the user has NOT agreed to it, so do not retry it or rephrase it to bypass the gate. Treat unconfirmed / not executed / possibly unattended / the user has not decided for you as a fact and judge yourself how to finish all the rest of the work normally; do not let this one action stall the task. IMPORTANT: the gate does NOT block git push, builds, packaging or ordinary file edits in the workspace; these are normal tasks this round should carry through. Prefer not to call ask_user (nobody may be online), and prefer not to run operations that would touch key areas; do not make decisions on the user behalf that they might dislike. If you do need a decision, an inquiry card is still available as a fallback and has the same 2-minute timeout. Never report a blocked key-area action as done. If no action is needed, say so in one or two sentences. Jobs you start from this run will not wake the agent again.
